verdict.rationale: MoonPay delivers fiat-to-crypto through REST endpoints (quotes, sessions), a Web SDK, and hosted widgets on 'our rails'. Integrators run the payments, KYC, wallet creation, and cross-chain bridging flows without operating any chain infrastructure. The docs also support generating type-safe clients from the OpenAPI spec for other languages. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that nodes and gas fees are handled by MoonPay (only implied), first-party SDKs beyond the Web/JS SDK (other languages rely on codegen, and the OpenAPI spec was not found at common paths), and independent hands-on corroboration.
